# Unity Per-Object Outline RenderGraph reference

The interaction highlight is adapted from Unity Technologies' **Per-Object Outline RenderGraph Renderer Feature Example** for Unity 6:

https://github.com/Unity-Technologies/Per-Object_Outline_RenderGraph_RendererFeature_Example

The reference implementation is licensed under the Apache License 2.0. The project implementation was adapted to support runtime interaction targets, separate greyscale/color-camera colors, opacity animation, configurable softness, and an always-visible interaction silhouette.
